title: Senior Software Engineer
tagline: Fintech & Core Banking · Manufacturing · Distributed Systems · ASP.NET Core & Mendix
mission: I design and ship high-throughput enterprise systems — bridging robust backend architectures (.NET Core, distributed messaging) with low-code enterprise platforms across fintech, banking, and manufacturing.
summary: Senior Software Engineer with extensive experience in architecting and modernizing high-scale enterprise systems across Fintech, Core Banking, and Smart Manufacturing (MES/MOM). Expert in building distributed microservices using ASP.NET Core, RabbitMQ, and gRPC, complemented by rapid enterprise application delivery with Mendix. Proven track record in optimizing high-concurrency workloads and leading technical migrations.
objective: Career objective: Transition into a Technical Lead / System Architect role — leveraging strong system design, enterprise modernization, and hybrid tech stacks (.NET + Low-Code) to deliver scalable solutions while mentoring engineering teams. Open to onsite collaboration with global clients.
authorNote: I started this site as a learning lab: publish what I actually ship in fintech, manufacturing, and .NET, keep a public trail of deep-dives, and turn recurring architectural patterns into actionable knowledge.

bullets: Architect and engineer digital manufacturing execution solutions, integrating custom .NET backend with the Mendix enterprise low-code platform.
Implement complex business logic, domain models, and custom connectors to extend low-code platform capabilities.
Drive code reviews, optimize database queries for high-volume telemetry/event data, and uphold clean architecture standards across the squad.
Delivered critical features for core payment ecosystems handling massive transaction volumes (QRCode, POS, mPOS, Pay4Biz).
Refactored legacy WCF (.NET Framework) services and executed phased migration to ASP.NET Core following modern RESTful architecture.
Optimized QR code generation API under heavy load conditions (JMeter), successfully slashing average response times from ~30s to ~5s.
Enforced rigorous code review guidelines and CI/CD best practices to elevate overall code quality.
Delivered onsite technical deployment and mission-critical production troubleshooting in Myanmar for enterprise core banking rollouts.
Designed secure OTP multi-factor authentication and high-reliability teller transaction APIs on Neptune Core Banking.
Integrated distributed services utilizing gRPC and RabbitMQ for low-latency, event-driven banking operations.
Maintained and resolved zero-downtime production issues on legacy Optimal9 core banking (Java, Oracle, VB.NET).
Mentored junior engineers on core banking domain flows and security standards.
Architected an orchestration flow for distributed microservices covering routing, workflow execution, and resilient inter-service messaging.
Engineered synchronous (gRPC) and asynchronous (RabbitMQ) communication patterns for decoupled scalability.
Built a high-performance API gateway layer using YARP Reverse Proxy with custom load balancing and middleware pipelines.
Leveraged C# Source Generators to achieve compile-time performance optimizations and eliminate runtime reflection overhead.
